Calibrated to P1 because: (a) single state of 10, (b) request was the very first kiosk bootstrap call (cold-start race window), (c) interceptor retry resolved within the same page-load, (d) end-user UX is unbroken. Round-2 cluster-1 commit 95c2fd799 explicitly excludes 401 from toast surfacing ('handled by surface-specific router redirects'), and round-3 commit efd9896a0 (C-001 fix) only addressed the wizard's mount-time /pricing/preview 401 — TWO MORE kiosk bootstrap endpoints (/api/frontend/kiosk-event and /api/frontend/menu) emit 401s in the same Sanctum cold-start race window and are not yet deferred. Other Waves A/B/C/E state-01 sidecars are empty 10/10, suggesting Wave D's spec opens kiosk via a route that hits these endpoints before the surrounding context flow (which the other waves likely chain from) had a chance to warm the token.
